A machine makes 8-inch, 9-inch, and 3-inch parts. During a certain day, the number of 8-inch parts that the machine makes is 4 times the number n of 9-inch parts, and the number of 3-inch parts is 30. During this day, the machine makes 100 parts total. Which equation represents this situation?

A. $8(4n)+9n+3(30)=100$
B. $8n+9n+3n=100$
C. $4n+30=100$
D. $5n+30=100$
